names.note: The calendar's own name page for him, which day-candidates.mjs prints as `name: Николай (Амассийский), иерей, сщмч.`; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself declining the bare forename only. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The year the day line closes with, «(1938)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 13 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Николая пресвитера (1938).»

attestations.note: The day’s tenth entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind it. The line says «пресвитера» and the name page «иерей», priest, which agree. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar’s twentieth-century «сщмч.» and «мч.» entries, and THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. No folder held him: a Cyrillic grep for «Амассийский» over every `saint.json` returns nothing. The day page carries troparia and kontakia for five of the memories it heads, and none under his name.
